post_title: 德上高速池祁段小米SU7碰撞起火致3人遇难，官方通报116km/h智驾巡航时间线
defect_topic: NOA 116km/h 순항 중 공사 바리케이드 2초 전 경고 및 97km/h 충돌 후 도어 잠김 배터리 화재 참사
raw_chinese_text: 官方通报时间线触目惊心：车辆以116km/h在NOA辅助驾驶下巡航，前方遇到道路施工改道。22时44分24秒系统才发出障碍物提示并减速，25秒驾驶员接管，26至28秒便以约97km/h高速猛烈撞击水泥护栏并瞬间起火，车内3人不幸全部遇难！从预警到撞车仅仅2秒，根本没有给人反应时间，而且撞击后断电门打不开，生生被困死在火海里！

korean_translation: 공식 발표된 타임라인은 충격적입니다: 차량이 NOA 보조주행으로 116km/h로 순항 중 전방 도로 공사 우회 구간을 만났습니다. 22시 44분 24초에야 시스템이 장애물 경고를 울리며 감속했고, 25초에 운전자가 개입했으며, 26~28초에 시속 약 97km/h로 콘크리트 방호벽을 들이받고 즉각 화재가 발생해 탑승자 3명 전원이 사망했습니다! 경고에서 충돌까지 겨우 2초라 대처할 시간이 없었고, 충돌 후 전원이 나가 문이 열리지 않아 불길 속에 갇혀 사망했습니다!
english_translation: The official timeline is chilling: cruising at 116 km/h under NOA, encountering highway construction detour. At 22:44:24 the system finally issued obstacle risk alert and decelerated; at 22:44:25 driver intervened; at 22:44:26-28 it violently struck concrete barriers at ~97 km/h and instantly caught fire, tragically killing all 3 occupants! Only 2 seconds elapsed between alert and impact, giving no reaction time, and post-crash electrical cutoff prevented doors from unlocking, trapping them in flames!
technical_root_cause: Perception classification latency on non-standard static barriers under pure-vision NOA (Standard edition without LiDAR). Impact severed 12V auxiliary power wiring before door latch unlock command could execute, trapping passengers during battery thermal runaway.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi EV issued official telemetry verifying driver takeover at 22:44:25 and impact at ~97 km/h, reiterating that L2 driver-assist requires continuous driver monitoring and that AEB does not brake for static barriers.

raw_chinese_text: 微动开关配半隐藏门把手，外面拉不开，里面找机械拉手像玩密室逃脱！真着火了车里只有两分钟逃生时间，谁能在浓烟烈火里掀开储物格盖板去扣绳子啊？外面救援人员看着里面烧成火球却根本打不开门，这种反人类设计不改，买车就是买棺材！

pinyin_keywords: bàn yǐncáng mén bǎshǒu (半隐藏门把手), wēidòng kāiguān (微动开关), mìshì táotuō (密室逃脱), duàndiàn suǒsǐ (断电锁死), 12V fùzhù diànyuán (12V辅助电源)
korean_translation: 마이크로스위치가 달린 반매립형 도어 핸들이라 밖에서는 당겨 열 수가 없고, 안에서 비상 기계식 손잡이를 찾는 것은 방탈출 게임을 하는 것 같습니다! 진짜 불이 나면 탈출 시간은 2분에 불과한데 누가 짙은 연기와 화염 속에서 도어 수납함 커버를 뜯고 와이어를 당길 수 있겠습니까? 외부 구조대원들도 불길에 휩싸인 차를 보면서도 문을 열지 못합니다. 이런 반인륜적 설계를 안 고치면 차를 사는 게 아니라 관을 사는 꼴입니다!
english_translation: A microswitch paired with a semi-hidden handle—from the outside it won't pull open, from the inside finding the mechanical latch is like playing an escape room! In a real fire you only have 2 minutes to escape; who the hell can pry open a storage bin cover and dig out a pull cord in thick smoke and flames? Rescuers outside watch it turn into a fireball unable to open the doors—without changing this anti-human design, buying the car is buying a coffin!
technical_root_cause: Exterior door handle relies exclusively on an electronic microswitch and 12V actuator with zero external mechanical linkage. Severe collisions crushing front subframes sever 12V power, deadlocking exterior handles. Interior mechanical pull cables are concealed inside lower door pockets without photoluminescent markers.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi explained that internal mechanical releases exist in door storage compartments and comply with current regulations, while China MIIT subsequently drafted mandatory standard GB 48001-2026 requiring physical exterior mechanical handles.

defect_topic: 상하이 톈마 서킷 주행 중 순정 NAO 브레이크 패드 마찰재 전소 및 페달 허탈 타이어벽 충돌
raw_chinese_text: 踩下刹车踏板瞬间感觉完全空了，直接到底没有任何制动力！车速根本降不下来，只能眼睁睁看着车头撞进天马T1弯的轮胎墙。拆下刹车卡钳一看，原厂刹车片几乎磨平烧焦，摩擦材料全脱落了，直接是金属背板在摩擦刹车盘！600多匹马力的车配个纸片刹车片，拿命开呢？
raw_quote: 踩下刹车踏板瞬间感觉完全空了，直接到底没有任何制动力！车速根本降不下来，只能眼睁睁看着车头撞进天马T1弯的轮胎墙。拆下刹车卡钳一看，原厂刹车片几乎磨平烧焦，摩擦材料全脱落了，直接是金属背板在摩擦刹车盘！600多匹马力的车配个纸片刹车片，拿命开呢？
pinyin_keywords: zhǐpiàn shāchē (纸片刹车), Tiānmǎ sàidào (天马赛道), rè shuāijiǎn (热衰减), NAO chēpí (NAO刹车皮), shāchē tàbǎn cáikōng (踏板踩空)
korean_translation: 브레이크 페달을 밟는 순간 완전히 푹 꺼지며 바닥까지 닿았고 제동력이 전혀 없었습니다! 속도가 전혀 줄지 않아 톈마 서킷 T1 코너의 타이어 방호벽에 전면이 그대로 처박히는 것을 지켜볼 수밖에 없었습니다. 캘리퍼를 분해해보니 순정 브레이크 패드가 거의 다 타서 마모되었고, 마찰재가 전부 떨어져 나가 금속 백플레이트가 디스크를 그대로 갉아먹고 있었습니다! 600마력이 넘는 차에 종이 브레이크 패드를 넣고 목숨 걸고 타라는 겁니까?
english_translation: The moment I stepped on the brake pedal, it went completely limp straight to the floorboard with zero stopping power! The vehicle could not decelerate at all, and I could only watch helplessly as the front smashed into the Tianma T1 tire barrier. When we removed the brake calipers, the OEM brake pads were completely incinerated and ground down to bare metal backing plates scraping against the discs! 600+ horsepower car equipped with paper-thin brake pads—betting life on this?
technical_root_cause: Xiaomi SU7 Max is factory fitted with street-oriented NAO (Non-Asbestos Organic) brake pads. Under severe track braking on a 2.2-ton chassis, rotor temperatures exceeded 600°C, causing complete organic resin pyrolysis ablation and brake fluid boiling (vapor lock).
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi EV Q&A Episode 12 officially stated that SU7 Max is a high-performance luxury street sedan designed for public roads and advised against entering race tracks without professional brake, tire, and cooling upgrades.

korean_translation: 캘리퍼를 탈거해 실측해보니 브레이크 패드의 유효 마찰 면적이 믿기지 않을 정도로 작습니다! 673마력에 2톤이 넘는 순수 전기 괴물에 들어간 브레이크 패드 크기가 모델 3 롱레인지보다 작고 두께도 종이짝처럼 얇습니다. 홍보할 때는 브렘보 캘리퍼라고 요란을 떨더니 안에는 손톱만 한 민간용 NAO 패드를 쑤셔 넣어 겉만 번지르르합니다!
english_translation: When we disassembled the caliper and measured it, the effective friction area of this brake pad was unbelievable! manufacturer_response: Xiaomi defended its design stating public road 100-0 km/h stopping distance is 33.3m meeting standard safety metrics, though aftermarket track pads were subsequently made available.

korean_translation: 출시 행사 당일 분위기에 휩쓸려 5,000위안 계약금을 결제했고 공식 앱에는 분명 7일간의 숙려기간(환불 가능)이 있다고 적혀 있었습니다. 그런데 옵션 프리뷰 화면에서 모호한 팝업창이 떠 실수로 '옵션 잠금'을 누르자마자 5,000위안이 즉시 몰수되었고 1초의 철회 기회도 주지 않았습니다! 전국 수백 명의 소비자가 단체방을 만들어 항의했지만 고객센터는 '이미 생산 라인에 배정되어 환불 불가'라고 강경하게 버텼습니다. 명백한 기만 유도 판매입니다!
english_translation: Swept up by the launch hype, I paid the 5,000 RMB deposit since the official app clearly promised a 7-day refund grace period. But while browsing configurations, an ambiguous pop-up appeared, and an accidental tap on 'Lock Configuration' instantly forfeited my 5,000 RMB without a single second to reconsider! Hundreds of consumers formed protest groups on Black Cat, but customer service coldly maintained 'locked orders entering production are non-refundable'—pure deceptive sales entrapment!
technical_root_cause: Dark pattern mobile UX in Xiaomi Auto App. Placing irreversible 'Lock Configuration' call-to-action buttons without two-step biometric authentication or mandatory cooling-off countdowns led to accidental order commitments.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi officially clarified that three confirmation prompts exist before locking configurations, insisting that once locked, vehicles enter factory production sequencing and deposits cannot be refunded.

korean_translation: 샤먼 샹안 인도센터에서 출고해 겨우 39km 주행했는데 고가도로 위에서 차가 미친 듯이 경고를 쏟아냈습니다: '차량이 곧 종료되니 안전하게 정차하십시오', '구동계 고장, 변속 불가'! 액셀이 전혀 먹지 않고 차는 도로 한복판에 전원이 꺼지며 뻗어버렸습니다. 인도센터로 견인해 반나절을 점검해도 원인을 못 찾아 베이징 공장으로 보내 분해 분석해야 한답니다! 새 차가 고철이 되었는데 차를 바꿔달라니 몇 달을 다시 줄 서서 기다리랍니다!
english_translation: Just 39 kilometers after driving out of the Xiamen Xiang'an delivery center, the center display began flashing frantic alarms: 'Vehicle shutting down soon, please pull over safely' and 'Drive system failure, unable to shift gears'! The accelerator became completely unresponsive and the car bricked in the middle of the road. After towing it back, the service center couldn't diagnose the issue and said it had to be shipped back to Beijing factory for teardown analysis! My brand-new car became scrap metal, and when I requested a replacement, they told me to get back in line for months!
technical_root_cause: High-voltage inverter power stage transistor communication failure and CAN gateway packet loss, triggering internal safety microcontroller hard shutdown to protect the permanent magnet synchronous motor.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi offered a full vehicle refund or expedited replacement build slot along with daily transit compensation of 150 RMB/day, shipping the car to Beijing for quality analysis.

manufacturer_response: Xiaomi released OTA patches optimizing GPU memory allocation and strengthened QNX virtualization boundaries to isolate critical cluster telemetry from infotainment crashes.

english_translation: For the 'Carbon Fiber Dual-Duct Front Hood' option costing a staggering 42,000 RMB, Lei Jun promised on stage that it fully replicated the racing prototype with functional aerodynamic downforce and brake cooling channels. korean_translation: 우한 제다오커우의 베이 블루 시승차가 유턴 중 급가속을 하자마자 피시테일로 스핀하며 차 엉덩이가 도로 연석을 그대로 후려쳤습니다! 휠이 그 자리에서 찢겨 나갔고 서스펜션 로어암이 부러져 휘어졌으며 타이어가 터진 채 길가에 뻗었습니다. 딜러가 조수석에 타고 있었는데도 600마력이 넘는 차를 이렇게 과격하게 세팅해놓고 TCS 개입은 굼떠서 초보가 밟으면 바로 벽으로 처박힙니다!
english_translation: That Gulf Blue test-drive car in Wuhan spun out completely during a U-turn when the driver hit the throttle, slamming sideways into the curb! The alloy wheel was shredded on the spot, the lower suspension control arm snapped and warped, and the tire blew out leaving it stranded. The dealership salesman was in the passenger seat! With such extreme horsepower and sluggish TCS intervention, any rookie flooring it ends up straight in the wall!
technical_root_cause: Aggressive low-speed accelerator pedal mapping combined with wet asphalt and slow TCS slip-detection response, allowing high instantaneous rear-wheel torque to induce snap oversteer before electronic stability control intervened.
manufacturer_response: The Wuhan store explained the accident resulted from an inexperienced customer stepping too aggressively on the throttle on rain-slicked asphalt, subsequently restricting high-output drive modes during test drives.

korean_translation: 후산 고속도로에서 내비게이션 파일럿(NOA)을 켜고 달리고 있었는데 전방에 햇빛이 직사하며 교량 이음새의 짙은 그림자만 있었을 뿐 앞 차선에 장애물은 전혀 없었습니다. 그런데 차가 아무런 전조도 없이 비상 급제동을 걸어 95km/h에서 33km/h로 곤두박질쳤습니다! 안전벨트에 가슴이 강하게 졸렸고, 뒤따르던 대형 트럭이 상향등을 번쩍이며 급하게 차선을 피해 아슬아슬하게 추돌 참사를 면했습니다!
english_translation: Cruising on the Shanghai-Shaanxi Expressway with NOA active, the road ahead was totally empty under direct sunlight except for a dark bridge expansion shadow. Without warning, the car triggered emergency braking, violently slamming from 95 km/h down to 33 km/h! The seatbelt strangled my chest, and a semi-truck behind flashed brights and swerved, narrowly avoiding crushing my rear end!
technical_root_cause: Monocular pure-vision perception neural net false-positive obstacle detection. High-contrast solar glint cast transverse bridge shadow lines that the occupancy grid classified as an elevated stationary concrete beam, commanding high-deceleration AEB.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi technical engineers retrieved telemetry confirming shadow misclassification, pushing OTA model weight adjustments to cross-verify forward radar confidence before executing hard braking.

korean_translation: 시내 교차로에서 후방 차량에 30km/h 정도로 추돌당해 범퍼 외피가 찢어지고 범퍼 레일이 찌그러졌습니다. 서비스센터에서 분해해보니 리어 사이드멤버와 9,100톤 일체형 다이캐스팅 리어 플로어 연결 브래킷에 미세한 균열 변형이 발생했습니다! 정비사는 알루미늄 다이캐스팅 부품은 판금 견인이 불가능하므로 리어 차체 모듈 전체를 절단 교체해야 한다며 5만 8천 위안(약 1,100만 원) 견적서를 끊었습니다! 살짝 받혔는데 수리비가 차값의 절반입니다!
english_translation: Rear-ended at a city traffic light at ~30 km/h, cracking the bumper cover and denting the crossbeam. When the service center tore it down, the mounting boss between the rear longitudinal rail and the 9,100t integrated gigacast rear floor had micro-tear deformation! The appraiser gave an estimate of 58,000 RMB because cast aluminum cannot be straightened with sheet metal work—the entire rear sub-frame assembly must be cut and replaced! A minor bumper tap costs half a car!
technical_root_cause: Material limitations of heat-treated high-pressure die-cast aluminum alloys. Impact forces exceeding sacrificial crash box stroke transferred into the structural gigacasting ribs, which cannot be pulled, straightened, or welded without risking structural integrity loss.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi highlighted that its 3-stage rear crumple zone minimizes routine low-speed repair costs, but stated that safety-critical structural casting deformation necessitates modular assembly replacement to guarantee factory safety standards.

korean_translation: 전국 쇼핑몰 전시장과 1차 출고 차주들이 사진을 쏟아냈습니다: 조수석과 뒷좌석에 며칠 앉지도 않았는데 가죽 표면에 흉측한 주름이 자글자글 생기고 가운데가 붕 떠서 10년 된 노후 택시 시트처럼 늘어났습니다! 레이쥔 회장은 라이브에서 천연가죽 특유의 연신율 때문이라며 '사람들이 돋보기를 들이대고 본다'고 불평했지만, 수만 킬로를 탄 테슬라 시트도 이 정도로 무너지지 않습니다. 폼 밀도와 가죽 접착 공정이 불량한 것입니다!
english_translation: Showrooms across the country and first-batch owners posted photos: after sitting in the passenger and rear seats for just a few days, the leather surface developed ugly dead creases and severe bulging/sagging, looking like a 10-year-old worn-out taxi! Lei Jun complained in live streams that people are 'looking at the car with a magnifying glass,' but Teslas with 30k km don't collapse like this. The high-density composite foam rebound and leather lamination are clearly sub-par!
technical_root_cause: Insufficient polyurethane foam core density and low-tensile lamination adhesive bond, causing natural Nappa leather grain to separate and form permanent creases under concentrated occupant load.
manufacturer_response: Lei Jun commented in a live stream that showroom cars endure thousands of visitors daily and that genuine leather naturally stretches, assuring that factory production lines would adjust pre-tensioning.

korean_translation: 오후 내내 땡볕에 차를 세워뒀더니 전면 헤드램프와 우측 펜더의 이음새가 들뜨며 불룩 튀어나왔습니다! 틈새가 너무 벌어져 신용카드가 그대로 들어갈 지경이고, 좌측은 2mm인데 우측은 6mm에 달할 정도로 단차가 심각합니다. 고속도로를 달리면 A필러 부근에서 바람 새는 휘파람 소리가 납니다. 서비스센터에 가니 직원이 플라스틱 열팽창에 의한 정상 변형이라고 하는데 조립 공차 관리가 너무 원시적입니다!
english_translation: After parking in the afternoon sun, the seam between the headlight and right front fender warped and bulged outwards! The technician told me it was normal thermal expansion of plastic parts—their assembly tolerance control is so primitive!
technical_root_cause: Differential thermal expansion between stamped aluminum fender panels and injection-molded polyurethane bumper fascias. Inadequate clip slip clearances caused lateral expansion to buckle the corner outwards.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi issued a technical service bulletin to authorized delivery hubs providing revised clip brackets and re-torquing procedures under warranty.

korean_translation: 고속도로에서 흔한 교량 이음새 요철을 지나는데 '쿵' 하는 굉음과 함께 공기압 센서가 2.9에서 즉시 0으로 떨어졌습니다! 우측 앞바퀴 사이드월이 찢어지며 펑크가 났고 21인치 단조 휠 림이 크게 깨졌습니다. 트렁크를 열어보니 스페어 타이어는커녕 액체 실런트 한 통만 들어있었습니다! 땡볕 아래 갓길에서 견인차를 4시간 동안 기다렸습니다. 이 21인치 초편평 타이어는 폼만 잡았지 도로 요철을 전혀 견디지 못합니다!
english_translation: Hitting an ordinary highway bridge expansion joint, there was a deafening 'thud' and tire pressure instantly plunged from 2.9 bar to 0! The right front outer sidewall tore open, bulged, and blew out, taking a chunk out of the 21-inch forged alloy wheel rim. Popping the trunk, there was zero spare tire—only a bottle of tire sealant! I baked in the emergency lane for 4 hours waiting for a flatbed. These 21-inch ultra-low-profile tires are vanity fashion!
technical_root_cause: Ultra-low aspect ratio sidewall (35-series) on a 2,205 kg chassis. Impacting sharp pothole edges at highway speed pinched tire carcass cords against the rigid alloy rim lip, causing blowout.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi provided free roadside assistance dispatch and highlighted tire insurance options, while advising users in regions with poor road infrastructure to choose 19-inch standard wheels.

english_translation: In Shenyang at -18°C parked outside overnight. technical_root_cause: Low-temperature elastomer shrinkage in pneumatic valve blocks and dual-chamber air spring bladders at -18°C, dropping reservoir pressure and causing the chassis to rest on rubber bump stops.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi covered warranty strut replacements and deployed firmware updates that actuate pre-heating cycles for pneumatic distribution valves in freezing weather.

korean_translation: 샤오미 부사장인 왕텅이 직접 모는 SU7 Ultra조차 주차할 때 '주차 보조 사용 불가' 경고창을 띄웠습니다! 레이쥔 회장이 라이브 방송에서 입이 닳도록 자랑하던 엔드투엔드 AI 모델이 일반 지하주차장에서 콘크리트 기둥 하나 제대로 인식하지 못해 체면을 구겼습니다! 임원 본인이 매일 타는 차도 버그투성이인데 수천만 원을 주고 산 일반 소비자는 무보수 베타테스터 신세니 이 자율주행의 거품이 얼마나 심한 겁니까?
english_translation: Even a grand Xiaomi Vice President driving an SU7 Ultra gets 'Function Unavailable' during parking! The end-to-end foundation model Lei Jun bragged about on livestream can't even recognize a concrete pillar in a basement. The slap in the face came way too fast! When executives encounter daily bugs, retail buyers are unpaid beta testers—how bloated is the smart driving hype?
technical_root_cause: Ultra-wide perception model edge-case failure under subterranean fluorescent lighting glare and low-contrast concrete columns, triggering safety supervisor fallback into disabled state.
manufacturer_response: Executive Wang Teng playfully responded that development builds were testing bleeding-edge experimental models, promising continuous OTA iterations.

korean_translation: 숏폼 영상에 출고 첫날 부스트 쏘다가 앞범퍼를 박살 낸 영상이 넘쳐납니다! 스티어링 휠의 Boost 버튼을 누르면 673마력이 아무런 경고도 없이 쏟아져 나오는데, 100마력대 내연기관차만 몰던 젊은 운전자들은 제로백 2.78초의 폭발적인 토크를 전혀 감당하지 못합니다. 출발 시 운전대가 조금만 틀어져도 차가 그대로 튕겨 나가며 화단과 가로등을 들이받습니다! 아무런 안전 교육 검증도 없이 흉기급 출력을 쥐어준 꼴입니다!
english_translation: Short video platforms are flooded with clips of day-one owners crashing during launch starts! Hitting the Boost button on the steering wheel unleashes 673 hp without warning. Young drivers used to 150 hp gas cars cannot control 0-100 km/h in 2.78s instantaneous torque. If the wheel is turned even slightly, the car slingshots into median barriers and lamp posts! Handing track-level power to novices without graduated skill gating is giving a bazooka to a toddler!
technical_root_cause: Absence of steering-angle torque-limiting clamps during Boost launch mode. Delivering full 838 Nm torque when the steering wheel deviates even 5° from straight creates violent yaw moments exceeding novice steering counter-reaction speeds.
manufacturer_response: Xiaomi implemented mandatory in-app safety video tutorials and mileage threshold unlocking requirements before Boost and Launch control modes can be engaged.
